items.title: A protease-containing kiwifruit alters postprandial plasma and brain bioamine concentrations in a growing pig model for adult humans.
items.summary: Objective: In vitro digestion and fermentation studies show kiwifruit (KF) modulates bioamines but whether this translates to central neurochemical changes in vivo remains unclear.

items.title: Amphora coffeaeformis supplementation attenuates cypermethrin-triggered neurotoxicity, oxidative deficit, proinflammatory and apoptotic‑associated genes dysregulation, and histopathology in the brain of nile tilapias.
items.summary: Cypermethrin (CYP), a neurotoxic pesticide, is released into the environment uncontrollably, posing a particular threat to aquatic species.
